title: CricXZ Article Data V1
description: Editorial worksheet data for one CricXZ article. Stable site constants and deterministic URLs are intentionally derived outside this object.

slug.description: Stable lowercase, hyphen-separated article slug. Temporary wording such as latest or breaking is an editorial warning, not a schema error.

seoTitle.description: Article-specific SEO title without the template-appended | CricXZ suffix.

headline.description: Reviewed visible article headline used as the page H1 and schema headline.

metaDescription.description: Factual article-specific description for search and social metadata.

categoryLabel.description: Human-readable category label displayed on the article and News card.

filterCategories.description: News-page filter tokens written to the card data-category value.

articleType.description: Controlled editorial type; a renderer may map it to optional visible report-type wording.

deck.description: Concise reviewed summary displayed beneath the headline and reused for cards unless overridden.

publicationDatetime.description: Real ISO 8601 publication date and time. It must never be inferred from a file or system date.

modifiedDatetime.description: Optional genuine post-publication editorial or factual update time. When present it must be strictly later than publicationDatetime; cross-field comparison is a future validator responsibility. When absent, schema dateModified derives from publicationDatetime.

heroImageFilename.description: Local filename only, following a <slug>-cricxz.<format>-compatible pattern. Exact agreement with slug and local file existence are future validator responsibilities.

heroImageAlt.description: Meaningful alternative text describing the editorial image.

heroImageWidth.description: Positive intrinsic hero-image width in pixels.

heroImageHeight.description: Positive intrinsic hero-image height in pixels.

heroImageCaption.description: Optional meaningful caption or image-provenance wording. Omit when unnecessary.

sourceCutoff.description: Optional factual cutoff for evolving matches, rankings, squads, injuries, or other changing information.

articleBodyHtml.description: Original, reviewed CricXZ article-body HTML. It must not contain an H1; full HTML and heading validation are future validator responsibilities.

sources.description: Genuine external sources only; URLs must never be fabricated. Original CricXZ reporting requires transparent handling in a future source-model extension rather than an invented external URL.

label.description: Descriptive source label; do not store copied excerpts or source text.

url.description: Genuine HTTPS URL for the external source.

relatedArticles.description: Optional manually curated internal CricXZ links; no recommendation behavior is implied.

url.description: Internal repository-style article or page URL.

summary.description: Optional concise explanation of the related item's relevance.

cardHeadline.description: Optional card-only headline override. Omit when the normal headline works.

cardSummary.description: Optional card-only summary override. Omit when the normal deck works.

homepageFeatured.description: Whether the article is approved for homepage promotion; this is an editorial decision.
